traditional: A soft contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts supports growth, fortune, and patronage - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Mind meets expansion. Easy movement between the big picture and the fine detail, with an optimistic cast to communication. The trine makes this a natural strength: Fluid shifting between generalities and specifics; the conjunction here generally reads as easy. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Thinking and growth flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what thinking and growth have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Strong for pairing vision with persuasion; watch overstatement.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
base: A big idea can become easier for other people to understand when the vision and the practical explanation support each other.

readerCopy.body: A big idea can become easier for other people to understand when the vision and the practical explanation support each other. When Mercury trines Jupiter, thinking expands without losing as much contact with useful detail, helping pitches, teaching, publishing, and ambitious conversations travel farther. The larger purpose can lead without forcing enthusiasm to cover missing logistics. A clear reason, number, timeline, or next step gives other people something concrete to join.
